# lab-project
Group members: Carter and Weston
The program asks the user for a name. The program then asks the user for a number 1-25. The program will then output the name
that the user inputted but every letter in the name is shifted down the alphabet by the number the user inputted. For example if the user inputted
Abe as the name and 3 as the number, the program will print Deh.
